known_pitfall_claim: Line 80 claims that the preimage under Sp(g) is formed from q ∈ pt(L2), but Sp(g): pt(L1) → pt(L2), so its argument must instead belong to pt(L1).
pitfall_counterexample: Let pt(L1)={u}, pt(L2)={v,w}, with the carriers disjoint. Define Sp(g):pt(L1)→pt(L2) by Sp(g)(u)=v, and let Σ_a={v}.
